scheme_name: Credit Card Scheme For Artisans And Weavers Of Handicrafts And Handloom Sector
other_conditions: Must be duly registered with the Handicrafts and Handloom Department of Jammu & Kashmir
Must be involved in production and manufacturing processes related to handicrafts or handloom
Selection of beneficiaries is made by a District-level Selection Committee headed by the General Manager of the District Industries Centre
benefits_summary: Provides a maximum credit limit of ₹2,00,000 with no collateral, including a loan component of ₹1,80,000 and a beneficiary contribution of ₹20,000, plus a 7% interest subvention for up to 5 years.
